'''TQ3-R1''' was a [[droid]] with [[Color|silver]] and yellow plating and a gray [[sensor]]. It had two [[Limb|legs]], a cylindrical body, and a dome-shaped head.<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> the droid was on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> in the [[Thieves' Quarter]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> [[Babu Frik's workshop|workshop]] of the [[droidsmith]] [[Babu Frik]],<ref name="TROS" /> a member of the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

The droid was stood amidst a pile of other droids besides an [[oil bath]] near the steps down into the workshop when a group of [[Resistance]] agents brought the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]] in for a [[complete redacted memory bypass]]. Not long after the agents left, the entire planet of Kijimi was [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Eternal]], although Frik managed to escape beforehand.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
TQ3-R1 first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
